currentCard.explanation: Артериальное давление измеряют манжетным аппаратом: на плечо надевают надувную манжету, соединённую с устройством, которое показывает результат. Результат записывают двумя числами: систолическим и диастолическим.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NHS L61–63 gives cuff apparatus that measures/displays arterial blood pressure: slot2. Thermometer measures temperature, glucose meter measures glucose and stethoscope listens to sounds rather than independently quantifying pressure(TEMP,GL,ST). A stethoscope can assist a manual cuff-based auscultatory procedure, but offered “Стетоскопом” alone is not a second pressure-measuring apparatus; the row contrasts complete instruments by measured function. No exclusion of stethoscope-assisted measurement is asserted. Four real familiar medical devices, consistent instrumental case, unique offered complete pressure instrument.

absoluteLevel.ground: Upper-arm cuff blood-pressure apparatus is familiar to broad adult population through ordinary health checks. Distinguishing pressure,temperature,blood glucose and listening devices requires general medical-device knowledge; no professional numeric thresholds or manual-auscultation technique needed. Stethoscope remains a meaningful same-category distractor.
